name: Britt Larsdóttir
role: Aerial extraction and rapid transit pilot — getaway pilot
location: Steamvent Alley — geothermal district, hot and chemical-smelling, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Tenzin Ahlstrom-Quartey is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 40, her expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct ne — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. She works as a getaway pilot out of Steamvent Alley, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Tenzin Ahlstrom-Quartey lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
coping_mechanisms: Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
psychology.secret: Tenzin Ahlstrom-Quartey sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "Vertical extraction in thirty seconds. Don't be late."
"I fly things that aren't supposed to fly in places they aren't supposed to go."
"Airspace regulations are for people who file flight plans. I don't file flight plans."

story_hooks: A dead drop Tenzin Ahlstrom-Quartey maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Tenzin Ahlstrom-Quartey discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A Tier 4 executive offers Tenzin Ahlstrom-Quartey a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: Tenzin Ahlstrom-Quartey functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access. Cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex bombs in others
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally
old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.heritage: Northern European (Scandinavian) with Southeast Asian and North African admixture — a striking genetic blend resulting in warm-toned skin with subtle olive undertones, high cheekbones from Southeast Asian ancestry, and the angular jaw structure common to Northern European heritage. The combination creates a face that reads as neither fully one ancestry nor another, distinctly cosmopolitan.
physical_description.build: Rawboned and efficient — long-limbed with minimal body fat, the physique of someone who trains for endurance and precision rather than bulk. Shoulders slightly forward from years hunched over flight controls.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; practical, no styling products
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with olive undertones — the result of blended Scandinavian fairness, Southeast Asian golden warmth, and North African depth. Slightly ashy cast from the chemical air of Steamvent Alley or chronic sleep deprivation, likely both.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined around the eyes; minimal grooming beyond function. Slight scar tissue at left temple. No cosmetics. Skin has the texture of someone who spends time in hot, mineral-rich air without proper skincare. Cheekbones prominent and well-defined, reflecting Southeast Asian ancestry; facial structure balanced between Northern European angularity and softer, warmer tones from mixed heritage.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple toward jawline — faint, old, possibly from a crash or street fight
Calluses across knuckles and palms — pilot and combatant's hands
Tattoo on inner wrist: minimalist targeting reticle in black ink, approximately 3cm diameter
Small burn scar on right forearm, thin and pale, consistent with old electrical contact
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — polished chrome with faint circuitry etching visible at the edges, worn without cover or concealment. Slight subcutaneous shimmer at base of neck suggests subcutaneous neural array beneath skin. No visible limb modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. Stands with weight balanced evenly, never fully relaxed. Moves with pilot's precision — efficient, calculated, no wasted motion. Eye movement is quick and systematic, as if still scanning instruments. Speaks sparingly; listens more than she talks.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional: reinforced flight jacket (matte black synthleather, multiple pockets, worn at cuffs), fitted gray cargo pants with thigh utility loops, scuffed steel-toed boots. No logos or branding. Wearing a subcutaneous wrist display visible only as faint luminescence under sleeve. One platinum ring on left ring finger — no obvious sentimental value, possibly a dead drop indicator.
